title: Preflight: QBR Pack + Renewal Follow-ups
content:
Morning preflight notes (quick scratchpad)

Goal: get QBR slides + renewal asks cleaned up, make sure open support items are on track, and have 3 clear asks for the customer execs.

Schedule
- 08:30 — 09:00: Finalize metrics slide + callouts (dashboard snapshot)
- 09:00 — 09:30: Run-through with Priya (rehearsal)
- 10:00 — 11:00: QBR with Acme Corp (sponsor: Lena Torres)

Accounts to surface in QBR / renewal status
1) Acme Corp (renewal 2026-05-20) — HIGH
   - Current committed spend vs actual: show 3-mo trend (tokens/day, latency p95, cost/unit)
   - Renewal ask: 10% list + committed burst capacity (need to confirm pricing math w/finance)
   - Exec sponsor: Lena (confirmed) — ask for op-ex justification slide
   - Risks: two SEV incidents in last quarter (2026-02-10, 2026-04-05) — include RCA summary and mitigation steps

2) BrightLane (trial -> expansion) — MED
   - Usage ramp looks healthy; ask: convert trial to paid pilot by EOM
   - Demo: show new batching config (latency improvements)

Support follow-ups (tickets to call out)
- CS-4721 (Acme) — tokenization mismatch on bulk import — owner: Maya (SWE) — target fix: 2026-05-14
- CS-4499 (Acme) — intermittent TLS handshake failures — owner: infra-sre oncall Jake — mitigation: auto-retry patched? need note in slides
- CS-5010 (BrightLane) — embedding mismatch; work with ML applied-ml team (Riley) for model mapping

QBR slide checklist (quick)
- [ ] Title + agenda + attendee list (confirm exec names)
- [ ] 3 metrics slide: latency p50/p95, cost/unit, error rate trend
- [ ] Incidents & RCA (2 slides max)
- [ ] Roadmap items relevant to Acme (dedicated pools, private deploy timeline)
- [ ] Renewal recommendation & proposed contract language (attach appendix)
- [ ] Action item table with owners + due dates

Talking points (short)
- "We saw steady consumption, and our optimizations reduced per-token cost by ~18% on your main workload; here are the config changes we recommend."
- "For the two incidents, root cause was KV cache eviction patterns — we deployed a hotfix and added tracing; next steps are autoscaling tuning and retention adjustments."
- "Proposal: move to Dedicated pool + 12-month commit to guarantee throughput for your peak period (Nov-Jan)."

Email follow-up templates (quick)
- Renewal intro (to send after QBR):
  Subject: Renewal proposal and next steps — Acme / Redwood
  Body: Hi Lena, thanks again for the QBR. Attached is the renewal proposal with pricing scenarios (10% list vs 7% list with 6-month ramp). I've highlighted the timeline and required approvals. Can we target sign-off by 2026-05-20 to avoid the November spike? -- Owen

Action items (my to-dos)
- [ ] Pull p95 latency by model variant (Acme-prod-v1) and attach chart — due EOD today — Owens
- [ ] Confirm pricing calc with Finance (Sarah) — get final numbers by 13:00 PT — Owens
- [ ] Ask Maya for quick note on tokenization bug status + estimated ship date — cc Priya — Owens
- [ ] Draft renewal appendix + legal-friendly language (use previous Acme appendix as template) — Owens
- [ ] Rehearse bridge script with Priya at 09:00 — Owens/Priya

Loose notes / reminders to self
- Keep incident RCA <2 slides, TL;DR to execs.
- If customer asks about private deployment timeline, call out "Q3 pilot" and do not promise GA.
- Prepare a fallback plan if finance pushes back on 10%: offer 7% + 3-month usage review clause.

Parking lot / questions
- Do we need exec-signed SOW or is PO enough for Acme? (ask Legal)
- Confirm whether dedicated pool can be provisioned in their preferred region (eu-west-1) — infra ticket?

Scratchy checklist before call (10 min)
- [ ] Mute notifications on laptop
- [ ] Open Confluence QBR template + highlight slides
- [ ] Slack Lena + confirm dial-in 10 mins prior
- [ ] Copy renewal pdf to meeting chat

End notes: keep this doc as living during the morning. After call, convert final action items to Jira (CS follow-up epic) and drop link into Confluence.

Unresolved snippets:
- Finance needs usage baseline for pricing tiers — ask analytics for last 12 weeks export (WHERE: analytics.redwood/acme/usage-export)
- Need a short sentence on "how we measure cost savings" that is customer-friendly (no infra jargon)

-- Owen
